description: This file contains multiple sections of shell scripts and library functions used for building, configuring, and parsing options within a larger software project. It includes license headers, utility functions, resource management, hook management, option parsing, and other supporting features to facilitate script automation and modularity.

methods.name: func_append
methods.description: Appends a value onto an existing shell variable, optimizing depending on shell capabilities.

methods.name: func_quote_arg
methods.description: Quotes a shell argument for safe evaluation or expansion based on specified modes.

methods.name: func_version
methods.description: Outputs the script's version information along with header comments.

methods.name: func_help
methods.description: Displays the short help message with usage instructions.
